tap.text: A single soft, friendly UI button tap: a short rounded wooden 'tock', dry, no reverb

key.text: A single tiny soft keyboard click, light and bubbly, very short, dry

nav.text: A gentle two-note rising marimba blip for a menu selection, short and dry

correct.text: A bright cheerful 'correct answer' chime for a children's game: three quick rising glockenspiel notes with a sparkle

combo.text: An excited rising run of five sparkling glockenspiel notes ending in a magical twinkle, children's game combo reward

wrong.text: A gentle, kind 'try again' sound for a children's game: two soft low wooden marimba notes going down, not harsh, not a buzzer

pop.text: A single satisfying cartoon bubble pop, juicy and bright, dry

star.text: A single bright magical star ding with a short shimmer, children's game collectable

crystal.text: A magical crystal being collected: shimmering glassy chimes swelling into a bright sparkling chord, wondrous and warm

jump.text: A cute cartoon jump 'boing' whoosh rising in pitch, soft and playful, short

swim.text: A quick underwater swoosh with a few bubbles, like a friendly sea creature darting forward

whoosh.text: A soft airy magical whoosh passing by, light and quick

crack.text: A large egg shell cracking open in three quick crunchy cracks, cartoon style

chirp.text: A tiny baby dragon giving two happy squeaky chirps, adorable cartoon creature

portal.text: A magical portal opening: a rising shimmering swirl of sparkles and soft synth, friendly and wondrous

guardian.text: A big goofy cartoon creature going 'bwomp' with a silly wobbly low tuba note, funny not scary

plank.text: A single wooden plank dropping snugly into place with a solid friendly 'clonk'

unlock.text: A treasure being unlocked: a small click followed by a warm rising harp flourish and sparkle

friendship.text: A joyful magical power-up for a children's game: a rising harp glissando and sparkling chimes bursting into a bright triumphant rainbow chord

levelComplete.text: A short happy level-complete fanfare for a children's game played on xylophone, glockenspiel and a soft brass section, ending on a bright chord

victory.text: A triumphant, joyful victory fanfare for a children's adventure game with bright brass, bells and a cymbal swell, ending on a big happy chord
